k_convention: fractional B; reciprocal vectors are rows in inverse Angstrom
hf_scope: Small-angle first-two-band comparison only; full three-band all-angle fit failed and enlarged model-Q sensitivity is material.
reference_type: Native TAPW pair centers and raw fixed-source wave projections
limitations: Native SOC omitted; spectator spin approximation
Area-two periodic cell or layer-twisted primitive boundary required

No microscopic interaction density vertex or HF solver
Fixed-state external NQS timing is not a native training preset
